# Let me try pressing UP 4 times to move the room up, so the green block aligns with the path.

        print(f"  Path {n['color']}: {n['boundary']}, pixels={n['pixels']}")

        print(f"  Player {n['color']}: {n['boundary']}, pixels={n['pixels']}")

</parameter>
</function>
